_readme: S607 SkyBode, 2026-11-08. Columbia's 26 local A.S./A.A. degrees still fail the degree check as incomplete: they name the degree total (60) and 'Columbia College General Education (CC-GE) Pattern or Cal-GETC Pattern' with no units. S605's read (columbia_ge_units) never loaded the CC-GE pattern page itself. This read loads it and prints how it states its units and any electives rule, so a reconcile step on local degrees cites Columbia's own words or the degrees are parked as Taft's and Los Medanos's were. One page load plus the links it follows, no model call.

questions.ccge_units: The units the CC-GE pattern page states for the pattern, and any rule for electives toward the 60-unit degree.
